database.heading: Database
database.footnote: The database storage area is separate from the uploads and cannot be measured as a disk from within the application. Shown instead is the size of the database itself, and below the largest tables including their indexes.

warningFootnote: A daily run records disk usage and sends an e-mail as soon as a threshold is newly crossed. If usage stays at the same level, no second mail follows.

blockedIps.title: Blocked IP addresses
blockedIps.hint: Requests from these addresses are rejected before any league or match data is touched. Intended for addresses that permanently fail and only fill up the error log. Two things to consider first: a blocked address loses the entire application including login, not just the API — and one address may represent a whole site, such as a sports hall, a school or a club whose connection everyone shares. Addresses from private networks cannot be entered, because they could never match anyone.
